// REQ: LANG-1691 LANG-1692 LANG-1693 LANG-1694 /* Bouncing ball */ model BouncingBall "A simple model" parameter Real e = 0.7 "coefficient of restitution"; parameter Real g = 9.81; Real h(start = 1.0); Real v; equation der(h) = v; der(v) = -g; when h <= 0 and true then reinit(v, -e * pre(v)); end when; end BouncingBall;
